items.title: 68163_Tom Whaley oral history interview
items.q: Johnny Hodges, I used to have a job up there in the Avery Hotel... Johnny went up, the man hired Johnny and Johnny hired me as a manager

ctx.x: Cootie Williams. He was living at 131st with Chick Webb and I said to the guy go by and tell Cootie to come on by here, so Cootie come by and Duke was in there and I introduced Cootie to Duke and Duke, you know, they got together after awhile.

Just like Johnny Hodges in Boston. Johnny Hodges, I used to have a job up there in the Avery Hotel, it's a little place in a alley and they had the hotel there, next to Boston Street and we used to go up there and one day this fellow he had short pants on, come up there and he says can I play and I said sure, come on up and play. Johnny Hodges.

items.title: 68163_Tom Whaley oral history interview
items.q: I said to Johnny, you're going to Chicago... Johnny went back to Duke.

ctx.x: Duke talked to him -- I said to Johnny, you're going to Chicago and the man's going to double your salary. No, Que was the one that made him quit.

Yeah. Que said he got too much honor himself, he can't go. I said, he only had six people and he's making double the money. They were going to give him a whole lot of money up in Chicago and no, Johnny went back to Duke. I said, well, that's the end of that.
